algorithm.Title: Postpartum - Leg Pain - Female (Adult)
algorithm.ContentSet: IST Open-Source Guideline Content | Adult | Female
Definition: Postpartum leg pain assessment, generalized from NHS.UK's C-section recovery blood-clot warning sign to all postpartum deliveries, given the same elevated clot risk applies.
FirstAid: Call Qatar emergency services on 999 now. Keep the patient at rest and do not let them drive. Call Qatar 999 now, follow the call-taker's ambulance and emergency-transport instructions, and do not self-drive. Do not delay emergency care.

questions.Question: Is new weakness, numbness, facial change, speech difficulty, or loss of coordination the primary concern?
questions.Information: A continuing focal neurologic deficit belongs in the Neurologic Deficit pathway.

questions.Question: Is there swelling or pain in one leg (especially the calf), along with shortness of breath or chest pain?
questions.Information: NHS.UK C-section recovery guidance lists leg swelling/pain as a blood clot warning sign - the postpartum period carries an elevated clotting risk regardless of delivery method, and breathing/chest symptoms suggest the clot may have traveled to the lungs.

questions.Question: Is there leg pain or swelling without breathing or chest symptoms?
questions.Information: Any new leg swelling or pain in the postpartum period should be checked promptly given the elevated blood clot risk.

advice.Title: Emergency postpartum blood clot precautions
Content: Call Qatar emergency services on 999 now. Keep the patient at rest and do not let them drive. Call Qatar 999 now, follow the call-taker's ambulance and emergency-transport instructions, and do not self-drive. Do not delay emergency care.
Call Back If: worsening breathing difficulty; chest pain develops.

advice.Title: Urgent postpartum leg pain review
Content: Arrange prompt in-person assessment to rule out a blood clot; the exact non-emergency Qatar destination remains GOVERNANCE_REQUIRED. Call 999 if chest pain, breathing difficulty, fainting, or coughing blood develops.
Call Back If: breathing difficulty or chest pain develops; swelling worsens.

references: NHS.UK, "Caesarean section - Recovery" (blood clot warning sign), https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/caesarean-section/recovery/ (page last reviewed 04 January 2023) - generalized to all postpartum deliveries
